plan.name: 12-week General Fitness (Post-MI, Moderate Intensity)
plan.description: 12-week conservative gym program for a 58-year-old male cleared for moderate-intensity exercise post-MI. Targets general fitness, functional strength, mobility and aerobic conditioning while keeping intensity below ~70% age-predicted HRmax (~115 bpm). Avoids Valsalva and maximal lifts.

goals.name: Improve general fitness and functional strength safely
goals.description: Progress aerobic endurance, mobility and strength with conservative intensities appropriate for cardiac rehab clearance.

equipment.name: Full gym access (machines, dumbbells, cables, treadmill/bike)

days.name: Circuit of low-load strength and balance

activities.name: Standing calf raise (bodyweight or light dumbbell)
Diaphragmatic breathing and gentle thoracic mobility

checkpoints.name: 4-week check-in
questions: Any chest pain or undue shortness of breath during exercise?
Have you been cleared by your clinician to continue?

checkpoints.name: 12-week review
questions: Any new symptoms to report to clinician?

notifications.message: Keep heart rate below cleared limit (~115 bpm). Stop and contact clinician if chest pain, undue breathlessness, dizziness, or syncope occur.
Avoid Valsalva; breathe continuously during lifts. Use seated/controlled exercises when possible.
